notes.title: December Update | Message from the Devs and New December Playtest Times
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Once again thank you for signing up for our playlets! You probably don’t know how much we appreciate your feedback and engagement in the game that just three of us developers have made so far. We have learned so much and one of those lessons that we learned - get players collected at the same time during playtesting, so all of you can get an honest perspective of Shattle. 

So with that said we have decided to close servers in between scheduled playtest times. This way we will not only save on server costs during this stage of development, but we can provide a much better experience for you with 25-players at the same time. We’re also working on a new patch to create a better experience and an early Christmas gift. 😉

With that said, we are also including new time zones for December to include more of you around the world!


 Dec 4 @ 3 pm PST/ 6 pm EST
 Dec 8 @ 10 am PST/ 1 pm EST/ 7 pm CET
 Dec 11 @ 3 pm PST/ 6 pm EST
 Dec 15 @ 10 am PST/ 1 pm EST/ 7 pm CET
 Dec 18 @ 3 pm PST/ 6 pm EST
 Dec 26 @ 3 pm PST/ 6 pm EST
 Dec 29 @ 10 am PST/ 1 pm EST/ 7 pm CET


And once again, there are no NDAs, so stream all you want! We would love to see it! And don't forget to follow our social channels to keep up with development.

✨Reddit
✨Discord
✨Twitter

That's all for now. Look forward to seeing you on the battlefield!

-5 Fortress Dev Team
